scope: Every 53 SELECT asset (45 models plus 8 datasets) checked through HF hub_repo_details with matching repo_type. This checks current public repository metadata, not user-specific access or immutable file bytes.
fail_closed_rules: NO GATED marker does not prove weight file reachability or permission
Licensing requires full source text and applicable third-party licenses
Datasets must be queried as datasets, not model IDs
Unknown status is not a claim of removal; investigate repository, renamed IDs, and provider errors
No selected model may be downloaded from this metadata research artifact
